cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've advanced the charity our estimated auction takings. Now we just need bidders.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You borrowed five thousand. Only your mum registered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. One bidder keeps catering costs down. That's responsible fundraising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum's only coming to give us a lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must bid ourselves. Raise the card limit; protecting that donation has to come first.

mechanism: A grants increasingly reckless financial permissions while presenting them as duties necessary to protect a charitable commitment.
confusable: Ordinary stubborn fundraising is insufficient: B requests must be turned into authorizations that make the terrible plan seem responsible.
comparison: Borrowed donation and absent bidders differ from the restaurant weather-and-savings justification.
seedUse: Use D17-b promised donation and Mum lift revelation; make S01 approval govern the move to self-bidding.
